rows.behavior: kmaudit's tests pass on a machine with no global or system git config, as on a fresh CI runner, because the fixture's git helper commits with its own identity.
rows.fails_when: any kmaudit test fails or errors with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
rows.command: env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 uv run pytest packages/kmaudit/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
